name: postgresql_low_cache_hit_rate_otel
title: PostgreSQL low cache hit rate
description: Less than 95% of table and index block reads in a database were served from shared buffers over the last 10 minutes, while the database read more than 100 blocks per second from disk. The working set may no longer fit in memory.

query_condition.promql: (sum by (service_instance_id, postgresql_database_name) (rate(postgresql_blocks_read{source=~"heap_hit|idx_hit"}[10m])) / sum by (service_instance_id, postgresql_database_name) (rate(postgresql_blocks_read{source=~"heap_hit|idx_hit|heap_read|idx_read"}[10m]))) and on (service_instance_id, postgresql_database_name) (sum by (service_instance_id, postgresql_database_name) (rate(postgresql_blocks_read{source=~"heap_read|idx_read"}[10m])) > 100)
